method: Agent-led heuristic audit; observations are real app interactions or stated source review, reactions and repeat-use are hypotheses, not research-participant testimony.

records.expectation: Rename a saved meal without changing its nutrition.
records.observed: Saving a meal containing 18.3 g protein and 0.4 g fat is blocked by step=1 numeric validation.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely frustration and distrust: even a name-only correction cannot be saved.
records.recommendation: Accept fractional nutrition values and test name-only edits.

records.expectation: Type 18.3 g and keep 18.3 g.
records.observed: Sequentially typing 18.3 into the protein field displays 183; onChangeText immediately applies Number(v).
records.reactionPrediction: Likely unnoticed bad data or repeated retyping; physical-keyboard behavior still needs phone confirmation.
records.recommendation: Keep raw text while editing; parse and validate only on save.

records.expectation: Know whether records are local or account-backed.
records.observed: Guest setup says Your account saves changes automatically after Try on this device first. The later ready screen correctly says local.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely false confidence about backup; actual account saving is separate.
records.recommendation: Show storage copy conditional on guest/account mode.

records.expectation: A completed workout counts as a day of recorded activity.
records.observed: After one saved workout, You shows 0 of 7 days and Your first log starts the picture, beside 1 workout recorded. The headline reads meal-only loggedDays.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely sense that training did not count.
records.recommendation: Count explicitly defined activity days, or rename this as days with food logged.

records.expectation: See the load and reps actually performed.
records.observed: Profile Workout history shows reps only; the 45 lb load is omitted. Workouts Session history separately retains loads.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely extra navigation and doubt about whether loads were saved.
records.recommendation: Reuse the load-aware history rendering across entry points.

records.personas: Expert; six-month tracker; new calorie tracker
records.expectation: Reply and confirmation card agree on the numbers.
records.observed: Live correction prose says 23 g protein, 34 g carbs and 1 g fat; its card and saved meal use 18.3, 33 and 0.4. Server sums components but preserves independent answer.reply.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely uncertainty over which answer to trust; downstream total used the card.
records.recurrence: Possible on each generated estimate; frequency unmeasured
records.recommendation: Render numeric prose from canonical structured totals, or omit duplicated numeric claims.

records.expectation: Record the walk explicitly welcomed by onboarding.
records.observed: A 20-minute walk request was declined as unsupported resistance-training capture and redirected toward Build a workout. Tour says a walk counts.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely failed first success for a walking beginner.
records.recommendation: Support duration-based activity capture or narrow the introduction and suggested action honestly.

records.personas: Beginner; fit but new to calories
records.expectation: Understand where targets come from and choose sensible personal values.
records.observed: Fresh state uses 2000 kcal, 110 g protein, 250 g carbs and 78 g fat. Editor labels them samples but offers numeric fields without guided goal setup; web Nutrition calls them saved targets.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely treating defaults as personal recommendations or avoiding target setup.
records.recommendation: Mark untouched defaults at the point of use; offer a clearly bounded setup path or allow tracking without targets.

records.expectation: An approachable session suitable for the stated experience.
records.observed: Web defaults to Upper Body with 185 lb bench, 60 lb incline dumbbell press and other example loads. Native lists templates before showing their loads. No experience selection changes these templates.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely intimidation or extra setup; no claim that anyone attempted these loads.
records.recurrence: First workout and each new template
records.recommendation: Require deliberate starting-load choice; make beginner options and example status unmistakable before start.

records.expectation: Know what the exercise, sets and reps mean and how to perform it.
records.observed: Web exercise detail repeats load, sets, targets and adjustment instructions; illustrative photos do not provide movement instruction.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely leaving the app to learn the exercise; coaching preference remains a hypothesis.
records.recommendation: Provide concise terminology and credible technique guidance, or position this explicitly as a logger.

records.expectation: Change exercise order or skip occupied equipment without inventing sets.
records.observed: Web active flow reveals the current exercise and a noninteractive Up Next card. No reorder/skip/superset/rest/RPE controls found. Native exposes all exercises but lacks the web substitution form.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely parallel use of another training logger for advanced routines.
records.recurrence: Most sessions for users needing flexible programming
records.recommendation: Choose the intended training scope; add reorder/skip and program reuse before advanced progression claims.

records.expectation: Recover from an accidental finish or correct a saved set.
records.observed: Finish immediately saves a partial workout. Web then disables adjustment and removes rep-edit controls; native returns to template list. No reopen/edit-finished flow found.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely permanent incorrect history or resort to export-level repair.
records.recommendation: Provide a finish summary, undo/reopen, and bounded correction of saved sessions.

records.expectation: Keep kg as the display and entry unit.
records.observed: Workout inputs and history use lb. Live 80 kg capture correctly converted to 176.37 lb and disclosed conversion. Body weight separately supports kg.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely arithmetic or round-trip confusion in a kg gym; conversion is a positive safeguard.
records.recommendation: Add workout display/entry unit preference while preserving canonical storage.

records.expectation: Identify the purchase by its receipt date.
records.observed: Uploaded synthetic receipt dated Sep 25 appears under Sep 30 in pantry and grocery headings; note separately acknowledges Sep 25. receipt.date is capture day; purchase.purchaseDate is separate.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely confusion reconciling spending and pantry age.
records.recommendation: Label captured date versus purchase date and use reviewed purchase date in trip headings.

records.expectation: Save a batch from known ingredients without first maintaining full inventory.
records.observed: Empty batch form requires groceries with known quantities and nutrition. It provides no inline manual ingredient path. After pantry setup, fractional portions and undo work correctly.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely postponement by users who want a recipe calculator rather than inventory management.
records.recurrence: Every new recipe until pantry exists
records.recommendation: Offer direct ingredients or a clear guided prerequisite with preserved recipe draft.

records.expectation: Repeat yesterday's breakfast quickly with unchanged quantities.
records.observed: No direct repeat/copy/favorite action found in meal diary or editor. Recurring meal plans and prepared batches exist but require separate setup.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely continuing to use Chat or another tracker for habitual meals.
records.recommendation: Provide Repeat meal with reviewed date/portion; preserve provenance without double stock deduction.

records.expectation: Adjust a portion while retaining the original card for comparison.
records.observed: Fix it removes the proposal card and prefixes the composer with Correction to Breakfast. Correction requires another AI request; the original prose stays.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely uncertainty or abandonment if the next request fails; this run did return a replacement card.
records.recommendation: Keep the pending proposal editable or visible until a replacement is accepted.

records.platform: web and native navigation; web editor
records.expectation: Carry the selected day into the add-meal flow and correct dates afterward.
records.observed: Nutrition's Log a meal/Tell Spot navigates to Chat without passing selectedDay. AI request day is today. Web saved-meal editor has no date field; native editor does.
records.reactionPrediction: Risk of accidental today logs unless the user explicitly types the date; this is a handoff gap, not proof of every backfill failing.
records.recommendation: Pass selected day into capture and allow reviewed date edits on both platforms.

records.expectation: Useful variety or a clear choice to expand beyond limited pantry stock.
records.observed: One live dinner plan using a sparse oats/milk pantry returned Oatmeal with Milk on all seven days. It flagged partial nutrition and shortages correctly but prose claimed milk sufficiency while the stock check said quantity unknown.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely disappointment with planning value; one constrained example does not establish general quality.
records.recommendation: Ask pantry-only versus shopping-supported, offer diversity, and derive stock claims from validated quantities.

records.expectation: Recover a generated week after closing the dialog.
records.observed: Closing the generated unsaved seven-day plan and reopening shows Create my week with no draft. No unsaved-change warning appeared. Save draft exists at the bottom of the long plan.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely lost review effort and a second generation request.
records.recommendation: Autosave draft state or warn on close; keep save action reachable.

records.expectation: Plain-language choices equivalent to the web app.
records.observed: Native shows preferredStores, unknown, economy, flexible, open, usual and lower-case enum names; web has human-readable labels and select controls.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely uncertainty about unknown and open, especially when grouping is unclear.
records.recommendation: Map stored enums to user-facing labels and accessible group names.

records.expectation: Reps and load visible together with few taps.
records.observed: At 390x844 the first set weight editor occupies a narrow right column; the first reps control is below the initial viewport. All 12 set editors expand into a long scroll.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely more scrolling in the gym; actual phone timing unmeasured.
records.recommendation: Compact aligned set rows, combined load/reps save, and focus on active set while allowing jump navigation.

records.expectation: Interactive elements expose role and state.
records.observed: Native Nutrition date selectors and Your daily targets appear as text in the accessibility snapshot; corresponding Pressables lack accessibilityRole. Kitchen hero has the same pattern.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely harder control discovery; VoiceOver/TalkBack impact needs real-device confirmation.
records.recommendation: Add button roles, names and selected/pressed state; verify with assistive technology.

records.expectation: Continue directly to the saved product and portion.
records.observed: After Save my label the scanner reopens with blank barcode digits, requiring re-entry before adding groceries or food.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely redundant work after a long form.
records.recommendation: Retain the barcode and open the confirmed product automatically.

records.expectation: A reachable support destination.
records.observed: Help explicitly says no support contact is configured and to contact the inviter. This is understandable for invitation-only preview but not public launch.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely stuck after account/data problems outside a private cohort.
records.recommendation: Configure and exercise an owned support channel before public release.

records.stage: Log a simple meal without connected AI
records.expectation: Manual tracking includes an obvious direct meal form.
records.observed: Nutrition's Log a meal routes to Chat. No direct new-meal calories/macros form or ordinary food-name search found there. Manual label, pantry and workout paths exist, but require more context.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely confusion under the guest manual-tracking promise, especially without a barcode.
records.recommendation: Expose a simple manual meal entry and clear offline capture path.

records.stage: Turn a receipt into a usable pantry
records.expectation: A receipt quickly produces usable amounts.
records.observed: The synthetic three-line receipt was extracted, including nonfood; two food matches required review and quantities stayed unknown, disabling consumption. Product/serving confirmation remains necessary.
records.reactionPrediction: Useful honesty, but likely more work than the effortless receipt promise suggests.
records.recommendation: Show a short prioritized review queue with package-to-serving guidance; measure completion burden with real receipts.

records.expectation: Open a finished session and see loads and repetitions.
records.observed: Native recent session card displays title, date and total set count, with no detail action in the current screen. Web has a richer Session history dialog.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely native app insufficient as the only lifting log.
records.recommendation: Provide a load-aware native history detail and route from each recent session.

records.expectation: A short setup focused on the current task.
records.observed: One food/routine form combines restrictions, dislikes, favorites, household, budget, brands, stores, cooking equipment and workouts. Web has fourteen controls before save.
records.reactionPrediction: Possible optional avoidance due to setup burden; no human avoidance observed.
records.recommendation: Group by goal, support progressive disclosure, and retain defaults without requiring full completion.

records.personas: Fit but new to calorie tracking; beginner
records.expectation: A follow-up focused only on the missing portion.
records.observed: After an explicit breakfast statement with unknown peanut butter amount, Spot asked an appropriate portion question, then added that it needed context to decide whether this was a meal or grocery purchase.
records.reactionPrediction: Possible confusion about repeating information already supplied; the focused portion question itself is useful.
records.recommendation: Use intent-specific clarification copy and preserve the already-known eaten/purchased classification.

records.expectation: Runbooks describe the current storage and launch architecture.
records.observed: README and mobile README still describe manual snapshot transfer rather than automatic account saving, while current account UI, implementation and readiness repair notes describe automatic saving. Older verification counts also remain in README.
records.reactionPrediction: Likely incorrect debugging assumptions and release instructions; this is documentation drift, not proof that synchronization is broken.
records.recommendation: Reconcile the primary README and mobile guide with current account continuity, deployment and test evidence.
